title: Sweep the quantization bit width
summary: Sweep symmetric absmax quantization from 2 to 8 bits on weights with outliers, compare one scale per tensor with one scale per row.

mutants.columns_not_rows: Takes the maximum over axis 0, so it gives one scale for each column, not for each row.
mutants.divide_by_half_range: Divides the maximum by 2^(b-1), not by 2^(b-1) - 1, so the largest value cannot reach q_max.
mutants.max_not_absmax: Uses the maximum of the values, not of their magnitudes, for the per tensor scale.
mutants.round_half_up: Rounds with floor(x + 0.5), so halfway values round up and not to the even integer.
mutants.strict_threshold: Uses a strict less than, so an error equal to the threshold fails.
mutants.zero_row_nan: Has no rule for a row of zeros, so 0 / 0 gives NaN.
